text:
Anika: Quick sync on hybrid private-CP pattern: control-plane DNS for bootstrap, then publish per-tenant ENI as canonical. Need clear lifecycle + failure signals.
Rafael: Main risks: stale resolver caches and cert rotation windows on ENIs.
Kai: Suggest evented tombstone: on endpoint change publish short-lived tombstone IP (ttl=10s) for ~60s then repoint. Avoid NXDOMAIN.
Priya: Use reserved tombstone IP and document clients treat it as re-resolve signal. Also add Console status so customers see tombstoned vs canonical.
Anika: Security: two-step registration: connector posts /meta (cert_fingerprint + challenge), controlplane returns single-use bootstrap token (TTL 300s), connector calls /confirm with TLS proof. Log bootstrap events.
Rafael: Rotation: overlap certs for 10min; Console shows rotating. Add status enum: canonical, tombstoned, rotating, degraded, pinned.
Kai: Metrics: tombstone_propagation_ms, stale_hit_rate, re-resolve_success_ratio. Alert if stale_hit_rate > 1% for 30m.
Priya: Console: fields endpoint_ip, endpoint_fingerprint, last_seen, status, pinned_toggle. Enterprise_pinning = opt-in.
ops-bot: Deploy: connector v1.3 canary scheduled Wed 03:00 UTC (2h).
Anika: Action items: Rafael -> draft bootstrap token flow + RFC; Kai -> prototype tombstone flow + metrics; Priya -> Console fields + alerts. Review Fri ops-sync.
